name: kartograph
description: Explore a person's intent into intents/<date>-<slug>.md, extract its concepts into an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/, derive capabilities and Gherkin features under features/, build their screens UI-first on mocked data in a Kotlin Multiplatform app, plan and then make them real with double-loop TDD down to database, API and server, and walk the person through what was built.

interface.shortDescription: Draw out what a person really wants before anything gets built
interface.longDescription: Kartograph has seven skills that build on each other through plain files. kartograph-explore runs one exploring conversation with you and writes intents/<date>-<slug>.md. kartograph-knowledge reads an intent and records every concept it introduces in an Open Knowledge Format bundle at knowledge/. kartograph-features reads an intent and derives capabilities and Gherkin features under features/. kartograph-views builds a capability's screens and view models on fake use cases with sample data in a Kotlin Multiplatform app. kartograph-plan turns the capability's scenarios into an implementation plan: layer map, ports and adapters with exact signatures, one double-loop task per scenario with real code. kartograph-build executes that plan task by task: use cases, repositories, Room, Ktor client, platform capabilities and the Ktor server. kartograph-walk drives the running app scenario by scenario in front of you, asks whether each is right, and records your verdicts under walks/.
defaultPrompt: Explore my intent for a new feature with kartograph-explore
I have a rough idea for a product change — help me write down what I actually want
Extract the concepts of my newest intent into the knowledge base with kartograph-knowledge
Derive the capabilities and features of my newest intent with kartograph-features
Build the screens for the project-archiving capability with kartograph-views
Walk me through the project-archiving capability with kartograph-walk
Build the real behaviour behind the project-archiving capability with kartograph-build
Plan the implementation of the project-archiving capability with kartograph-plan
